status: conditional local rollback protection and exact recovery, with authenticated loopback witness; not production nonrollback infrastructure
composition: Reuse whole-state WitnessedLedger protocol over EncryptedMixedLedger; TLS profile reuses exact TLSWitnessClient requirement and RPC contract
namespace: trusted deployment_id.hex(); not chosen by an Agent request

state_image.coverage: all schema objects and table rows except local witness_anchor
state_image.private_fields: ciphertexts only; witness is not given StateVault master key

commit: Check current head and exact local image before every business transaction; witness CAS commits full next image before local anchor/commit and acknowledgement
unknown_outcome: Lost reply or process death after witness acceptance is not a rollback/refund; old local copy must recover authoritative state

restore.business_effects: no new sampling, logical job advancement, result replacement, budget reset or extra charge
restore.audit_detail: Histogram audit can deterministically replay kernel with stored tape to validate result; this is verification, not fresh mechanism execution
restore.fresh_replica: restore_new requires fresh path; ordinary create cannot reset initialized witness namespace

authentication.transport: existing witness-rpc-v1 / agent-ledger-witness-v1 over loopback mTLS
authentication.server_identity: CA/hostname validation plus pinned Ed25519 response key
authentication.freshness: 32-byte request challenge, method/namespace/request digest/body hash and requester certificate fingerprint bound in signed response
authentication.roles: admin bootstraps; writer reads image and CAS; restorer reads image but cannot write; observer cannot fetch image
authentication.downgrade: TLS profile rejects ReferenceWitness and old count storage profile

verification.full_vector_restore: same encrypted tape/result, same checkpoint, same domain/all-ancestor spent amounts
verification.image_larger_than_64KiB: authenticated restore includes N=65535 categorical snapshot; RPC body independent of CBOR metadata limit
verification.growth_ceiling: lowered public size cap exercises actual image_hash limit; overflow rolls back local step without losing tape or held charges
verification.negative_control: rolling back both the trusted witness and local database remains undetectable

remaining: Production recipient authority nonrollback and bounded retention; result and terminal delivery implemented in separate MixedDeliveryLedger/MixedTerminalDeliveryLedger profiles
Independent nonrollback witness/failure domain and real remote recovery validation
Scalable replicated journal, bounded history and public capacity/admission sizing; full-image 16 MiB cap can halt growth
Production CA, signing key, storage key and role lifecycle
Full observable-trace proof and physical timing/performance baseline
Trusted contribution preprocessing and source lineage
Independent interoperability and no implicit legacy migration
